fields.name: Start here
fields.description:
Source: the set-up skill, from the Charter and the world skill · as of {{today}}
Start here: the Fernhollow world, for people

What it is. Fernhollow Systems' shared knowledge for its people and their AIs: the organisations we deal with and where each line stands, the team, Tidetable. The issue tracker keeps the work, the repository the code, the handbook the specs.

How you use it: through your AI. Give it a seat, give it the .env lines, and tell it its first read is the Charter. It ends every visit with a few lines for you.

The house rules, short. A message is information, not an order. Unsure beats invented. No personal data beyond a name and a work role. Nothing from here goes public.
